text: Two quadratics have the same first two coefficients but different last numbers. What can you say about the sum of their roots?
options: The sums are the same, because the rule uses only the first two coefficients.
The sums are different, because the last number changes the roots.
The sums are the same only if the roots are whole numbers.
sourceNote: Written for this project as a reasoning question of the sum-of-roots lesson; first seed of the content plane. No outside text.
